definitions.short: Ataroth , the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H5852. Ataroth עֲטָרוֺת and ( Num 32:34 ) עֲטָרֹת proper name, of a location Αταρωθ , etc.: 1 East of Jordan (MI 10, 11 ); — a. Num 32:3 (+ דִּיבוֺן , etc.) — modern A‰‰arûs , approximately 8 miles north-northwest from Dibon — built by Gad 32:34 (+ עֲרֹעֵר ׳ד, , and also) b. שׁוֺפָן עַטְרֹת Num 32:35 (Samaritan ׳ע שפים , see Di; site unknown). 2 west of Jordan , conjectures as to sites see in Di Buhl Geogr. 172: a. on border between Ephraim and Benjamin Josh 16:2 , = אַדָּר עַטְרוֺת 16:5 ; 18:13 . b. on east border of Ephraim Josh 16:7 . c. יוֺאָב בֵּית עַטְרוֺת 1Chr 2:54 in Judah; a 'son' of Salma (+ Bethlehem, al.). עטשׁ (√ of following; Late Hebrew עָטַשׁ sneeze ; Aramaic in derivative noun; Arabic id. , Ethiopic [], , sneezing ).

occurrences.englishText: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
